allocation.note: 1 request per product; byte budget split 65536+65536=131072 to match aggregate; row budget split 5+5=10; time is a shared 15s wall-clock (global deadline binds) with per-source 15s upper bound; concurrency 1 sequential.

request_accounting.note: Only the initial request per product is permitted (1+1=2 total). Any redirect hop or 429/503 retry would consume budget first and then abort with METADATA_REDIRECT_NOT_PERMITTED / METADATA_RETRY_NOT_PERMITTED. Remaining budget is decremented before a hop is followed. Host allowlist is checked on every Location before a redirect is followed (all redirects abort here). Total budget is 2 across both products, separate from the payload pilot ledger.

abort_conditions: HTTP status outside 2xx (no retry: 0 permitted on 429/503)
Any redirect response (0 permitted per request)
Redirect Location host outside the allowlist, checked before follow (all redirects abort)
A redirect or retry that would exceed the remaining request budget
Response bytes exceed the per-source max_bytes (65536) or aggregate 131072
Row count exceeds the per-source max_rows (5)
Required identity field missing or type-mismatched (CMS Provider CCN; CDC stateabbr)
Release-verification constraint failed (both releases must stay unresolved until first-party docs prove them)
Elapsed time exceeds the per-source max_seconds (15) or aggregate 15s global deadline
Duplicate query key on request or redirect Location
Out-of-scope URL, non-HTTPS, or host not in permitted_hosts
Any live request issued before AUTH-METADATA-CHECK is recorded

authorized_receipt_path.note: After authorization, captures must keep live_http=true so origin stays truthful. AUTH-04 and AUTH-PAYLOAD-PILOT cannot grant this path.

retention.note: Captured publisher bytes stay on disk and are gitignored. In-tree receipts bind their SHA-256. That is repository-contained evidence without republishing publisher rows in git. Separate from payloads/pilot-r04/.
